# orchard_cluster_settings (Data Source)

Retrieves current cluster settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "orchard" {
  token    = "your-service-account-token"
  base_url = "http://localhost:8080"
}

data "orchard_cluster_settings" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `host_dir_policies` (List of Object)
- `scheduler_profile` (String)
